target.statement: Mean Adjusted Rand Index for the object partition (ARI_U) on the small-size, low-noise simulation scenario (I=40, J=30, K=20, P=4, Q=3, R=2, sigma=0.1), reported as 0.984
target.dataset: Synthetic three-way array generated per Section 4 (core G ~ N(0,1), noise N(0,sigma^2))

compute.basis: Data is trivially synthesizable and the array is tiny (40x30x20), but no code is released, so the full ALS algorithm, 5-fold CV over a 12-point lambda grid, and the Hungarian label-matching must be reimplemented from the paper; runtime itself is seconds per fit (paper reports 0.02 s), so the estimate is dominated by implementation and validation.

blockers: No code released (available only 'upon reasonable request' from authors)
Exact simulation protocol details (nsim, initialization seeds, CV fold construction) not fully specified, so exact 0.984 value may not be bit-reproducible
title: Fuzzy entropic triple k-means
